description: The chart displays three pie charts, each representing the distribution of categories across different labels, namely "easy", "medium", and an unlabeled category. Each pie chart is divided into four slices, corresponding to the categories N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K-, which are color-coded as green, yellow, orange, and red, respectively. The "easy" pie chart shows N+K+ at 40.6% (green), N-K+ at 45.9% (yellow), N-K- at 10.1% (orange), and N+K- at 3.3% (red). The "medium" pie chart displays N+K+ at 44.6% (green), N-K+ at 44.3% (yellow), N-K- at 7.2% (orange), and N+K- at 3.9% (red). The third pie chart has N+K+ at 36.2% (green), N-K+ at 36.8% (orange), N-K- at 20.1% (yellow), and N+K- at 7.0% (red). A legend is provided on the right side of the image, indicating the color coding for each category. The percentage labels are shown inside each slice, and no slices are visually emphasized. The slices are not ordered in a particular way across the charts, but within each chart, the categories are consistently color-coded.
